_comment: Email content for the latest release. Update this each release as part of /release-update, then run send.mjs. Keep it to the highlights; this is an email, not the full changelog. British English, no em dashes, no emojis, no permanence words.
subject: InnerZero 0.1.8 is out
preheader: llama.cpp engine support, a unified AI and Models tab, open at login, and more.
intro: Version 0.1.8 of InnerZero is now available. Here are the highlights.

groups.label: New
items: llama.cpp engine support: point InnerZero at your own llama-server and chat, voice, and memory all route through it.
A single AI and Models settings tab that brings your engine, hardware, model assignments, and cloud keys together.
Open at login: an optional toggle that starts InnerZero when you sign in, on Windows, macOS, and Linux.
Action Hub saved actions and scheduling: save an action once, re-run it in a click, or put it on a schedule that always stops at a draft for your review.

groups.label: Improved
items: A shorter, better ordered Settings layout with wider model dropdowns so long names are readable.
Voice settings labels are now in plain language across all 26 interface languages.
Model downloads now show the real error message when something fails.

groups.label: Fixed
items: Sending a message while a file attachment is still loading no longer drops the message.
GGUF model names keep their quantisation tags in menus, so you can tell variants apart.
Every in-app hint that pointed at the old Mode tab now points at the right place.
